subject: The unreachable pre-G0 compatibility branch was removed from this suite and the surviving contract strengthened to require exactly one non-pass-through owner per theme. These mutations show the strengthened contract is red-capable.

mutations.intent: Make dark --elevation-card delegate its whole value to another custom property, so its ownership is nominal only.
failingOutput: FAIL  web/src/test/shadow-tokens.test.tsx > Elevation is tokenised, in both themes > every elevation token is defined in both the light and the dark block
AssertionError: --elevation-card dark must own its value, not pass it through: expected 'var(--elevation-popover)' not to match /^var\(\s*--[\w-]+\s*\)$/

mutations.intent: Delete --elevation-card from the light block, the exact case the deleted pre-G0 compatibility branch would have masked.
